release_notes: Table of Contents and Export update. TABLE OF CONTENTS: switching the active chapter now hands the cage over to it - the new chapter's cage becomes the live target of the Expansion tool while the previous chapter's cage is released; the Cage Vis/Hid choice now carries across chapters instead of resetting; and the whole Cage_BG hierarchy is hidden when you leave Export Settings and shown again on entry. EXPORT: reworked Export panel in Export Settings with a scope selector (Active Chapter / Active Book / All Books), Include HP / LP / Cage toggles, Separate vs HP+LP-in-one-file output, and By material / LP-in-one-file options for multi-chapter exports; the cage can be exported alongside the chapter. SESSION: the tool's settings are now saved automatically on every scene save, and a Save As writes the settings JSON under the new scene name. UI: the session row now carries Language and About buttons (About moved out of the log right-click menu); the About window shows a contact email for questions and ideas. LOCALIZATION: completed Japanese and Chinese translations for the Cage Settings and Export panels.
